findings.title: Primary cashier and treasury money requests lose original retry identity on process loss

evidence.explanation: Exact checkout retained only in private field; no journal save/recover.

Normal close gate is present; it cannot intercept power loss.
CallCenter checkout already persists operator-scoped DTO, so finding does not apply to its normal write path.

Repeat for refund, expense, safe drop, drawer transfer, shift open/close and treasury operations; assert server ledger unaffected on replay in isolated integration fixture.
findings.recommendation: Persist exact versioned typed financial request and owner before dispatch; expose recovery by original identity, block replacement until outcome known; no fixes performed.
